title: Number store
what: The gateway's own numbers on bun:sqlite: a number for every Discord channel, person and message in the ranges policy/discord.toml declares, which messages were handed over, each room's voice and each DM's person, in gateway/src/store.ts.

title: Reading and sending
what: The provider side of the gateway: a read message numbered and handed over with its origin, context and room facts, the avatar voice, the room answer and every send by kind and fields, with its refusals, in gateway/src/provider.ts and avatar.ts.

title: Discord REST calls
what: Every call the gateway makes on Discord's REST API: messages, edits, pictures, files, stickers, reactions, pins, typing and channel lookups, in gateway/src/api.ts.

title: Gateway seam server
what: The gateway process: its loopback routes (health, sends, a room, the owner), the bearer check, the hand-over of each message to the service once through the generated client, and the sockets started, in gateway/src/main.ts and seam.ts.

title: Gateway sockets
what: One Discord gateway socket per configured token: identify, heartbeat, resume and reopen, the intent refusal, and the reading of a dispatch into a message with epoch-millisecond times, in gateway/src/gateway.ts and events.ts.
